target: 100% archival completion of the selected original mobile route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Archival Mobile Setup
areas.location_cue: The original Japanese handset title screen and carrier-era application menu.
areas.note: This discontinued service title must be preserved before ordinary play.

items.label: Use the Original Japanese Mobile Release

levels.1: Only the discontinued handset version contains the game.
levels.2: Use a documented compatible Japanese phone with the original service build installed.
levels.3: Preserve the handset and its storage before launching. Keep the original application files, device model, firmware, carrier information, and service state together; no current storefront, verified dump, or dependable emulator route is documented.

levels.1: A surviving installation may be impossible to replace.
levels.2: Capture boot, menus, controls, every play loop, score screen, and failure state.
levels.3: Before pressing Start, record the title and option screens. Continue capturing without cuts through every distinct target sequence, damage state, score change, failure screen, retry, and any terminal screen; export the recording and handset files to two backups.

levels.1: The surviving build was distributed only in Japan.
levels.2: Photograph every menu and result string before translating it.
levels.3: Capture each Japanese screen at native resolution, transcribe its characters separately, and keep any translation in an external note. Do not replace original strings inside the archive or infer a menu function from icon appearance alone.

save_backup.title: Back up the handset first
save_backup.why: The only known route depends on discontinued mobile distribution.

areas.name: Verified Gameplay Loop
areas.location_cue: The dark target windows, keypad prompts, health display, and score counter.
areas.note: Only directly documented mechanics are presented as routine instructions.

levels.1: Dark windows demand quick keypad reactions.
levels.2: Press the corresponding handset button when a target appears.
levels.3: Keep both hands on the keypad, identify the on-screen position or prompt associated with each numeric button, and press once for every required shot. Record the mapping from observed play rather than assuming a modern touchscreen layout.

items.label: Fire Before the Attack Window Closes

levels.1: Waiting too long converts an encounter into damage.
levels.2: Shoot each visible target before its attack animation completes.
levels.3: Prioritize the nearest or most advanced attack animation, deliver the required number of keypad shots, and watch the health display after every miss. Retry the same sequence to verify whether timing or target order changed.

levels.1: Not every opponent is removed by one hit.
levels.2: Count successful shots separately for every visible target type.
levels.3: Start from a clean attempt, fire only confirmed hits, and record how many are required before each target disappears. Repeat the measurement because public records confirm variable durability but do not preserve a complete health table.

levels.1: The preserved descriptions mention scoring without publishing its table.
levels.2: Capture every score change, bonus, penalty, and final total.
levels.3: Note the score before and after each hit, defeat, miss, damage event, wave, and retry. If a multiplier or threshold appears, reproduce it in a second attempt before treating it as a completion condition.

levels.1: At least three mechanically different targets are documented.
levels.2: Encounter and defeat this target type during a surviving session.
levels.3: Wait until T-Virus Zombie is clearly visible, capture its complete appearance and attack animation, determine its keypad position and required successful-shot count through observed play, then defeat it without taking damage. Do not infer any narrative identity or role beyond the displayed target.
